verdict.rationale: Smooth's documentation says it runs its own "small and efficient AI models" and never documents a way to configure or bring your own LLM provider for the agent. The CLI working "with any agent that can run CLI commands" concerns which calling agent drives Smooth, not model choice inside Smooth, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models
